relationships.subject: idiopathic intracranial hypertension
relationships.evidence_quote: As compared with controls, both CM (p Adj<0.001) and IIH (p Adj=0.039) had significantly increased levels of CGRP.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Comparison of serum CGRP levels of these two groups revealed significantly higher CGRP levels in patients with sustained headaches

key_findings: Serum CGRP is elevated in chronic migraine and IIH versus healthy controls, but not in episodic migraine.
IIH patients with sustained headache after ICP normalization had higher CGRP.
